guideTitle: Captain Blast Level Tips and Stage Strategy
guideIntro: The safest route is to study the obstacle pattern first, make one clean move at a time, and avoid spending power or boosts before the level objective is clear.
steps: Pause for a moment at the start of each level and identify the obstacle that can fail the run.
Clear blockers before chasing score or bonus pieces.
Use timing windows instead of rushing repeated taps.
If a level repeats the same pattern, memorize the first three moves and keep them consistent.
Save any limited helper for levels where the final obstacle is the only real bottleneck.
